rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L19 chunk 1 'While the benchmark runs': 'when the scoreboard lands in phase 3' is the nearest to unresolved (scoreboard not defined before), but it is a session artifact the trio's own run produces (carve-out) and chunk 0 L7 names 'a scorer measures'. L56 chunk 3 'The scorer reads them' resolves to L7 and the L62 definition. L102 chunk 6 'which line it was' resolves to the flagged line in the judge output of the prompt directly above. Harm (reader cannot resolve a referent): absent.

grep for 'the opening lecture|earlier lecture|previous (lecture|file)|last session' in body -> no positional pointer to another file. L9 'the session opened at the start of the day' and 'Your three memories' name the lived module day, not a file by position.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L9 'Your three memories were curated from the same retrievals' and L96 'your curator's synthesis note': apt101-build-your-product-memory.md, apt101-gather-the-evidence.md and apt101-read-the-digest.md exist in the repo (grep 'synthesis note|overnight digest' hit them); L64 'the phase 2 files' resolves to L41 Phase 2. Diff-added L15 'Drop the summary after the colon' points forward to the prompt on the same slide, not backward at a beat.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L64 post-it prediction ('Each of you writes on a post-it which one will catch the most... Face down until the scoreboard lands') precedes the scoreboard prompt L66 and the reveal L68; no outcome narrated above a guess. Diff-added L15 'after the colon' has a verbed instruction and a same-slide prompt. Muted read of L43 added sentence 'If one comes back fast with almost nothing flagged, tell it there is more here' is a verbed sentence with a clear object; no pronoun bound to the screen.

Every chunk carries a self-carrying claim. Nearest to thin: chunk 7 'Take stock' L106 is a single paragraph but states the outcome (winning check is now a runnable file) and the Known limit; it is a closer, not a wait-state.

Closest: chunk 1 'While the benchmark runs: ready your real summary' (L11) whose body L15-19 is exactly readying the summary; chunk 4 'Phase 3: Let the scorer decide' (L58) matches L62-78. No header contradicted.

grep for 'Not .{1,30}\. Not' pattern in body -> none. Closest: L96 'The briefing was built to be caught. Your real summary was not.' is a contrast pair, not 'Not X. Not Y. Z.'; L78 'the row, the number, and what it means' is three concrete objects, not an empty-leg triplet; no superlatives, no number-plus-retraction (L29 'roughly one claim in ten' is a label with a hedge, not a retraction), no abstraction-noun stacks.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep for beat|mood|compendium|forcing function|firing|surface in body -> none (view greps for banned/dialect words CLEAN; direct check of body L1-106). Terms like 'benchmark', 'scorer', 'subagent/agent' are engineer-register and defined by the exercise itself.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Bold in body: L5 '**What you do:**' (widget label), L31 '**Don't open the briefing.**' (one element on its slide, 4 words). Closest to violating: L31 is a whole short sentence rather than a sub-span, but it is a four-word directive under the handle cap with the explanation as a separate sentence, one bold on the slide; harm (monoculture of bold lead sentences) absent.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Exercise file: content is the H1 lede plus `##` phase sections that reach the deck under the exercise wrapper; no prose-only phase-less section and this diff changes only prose inside existing chunks (L15, L43), not chunking or markers. Not re-rendered in both layouts this run; the claim rests on structure, mechanical render hash unverified.
